scope.repository: All git-tracked files plus non-ignored new files for the v1.2.0 release candidate; out/ and dist/ scratch artifacts are excluded from the source scan.
scope.installer: dist/goujian-strategy-slides-v1.2.0.zip, rebuilt deterministically after this record was added; final SHA256 and entry count are recorded in SHA256SUMS.txt and out/v12-control/phase4-evidence.json.
scope.not_scanned: The optional showcase ZIP and generated PPTX/PDF artifacts are not part of the installer; their manifests and review records are covered separately.

method: Enumerated every git-tracked and non-ignored file outside out/ and dist/; refused symlinks, private filenames, disallowed binary suffixes, files over 5 MiB and secret-pattern matches.
Scanned UTF-8 text for private-key headers, GitHub/AWS/Slack token shapes, generic secret assignments and absolute user paths.
Inspected the installer archive for integrity, duplicate names, symlink entries, forbidden suffixes, cache/output directories and exactly one root SKILL.md.
Checked the four direct dependency licenses and the committed lockfile registry hosts.
No secret value is reproduced in this report.
privacy_note: Fifteen historical v1.1-release QA JSON files had absolute home prefixes replaced with ~ in recorder tool paths only; verdicts, counts, hashes and timestamps were not changed. No other historical release document was rewritten.

npm_audit.limit: A zero result is a point-in-time audit, not a future security guarantee.

distribution_boundaries: No font file is distributed or embedded; fonts are referenced by family name only.
No private corpus, third-party corporate template, logo or licensed visual asset is included.
All showcase fixtures and screenshots are synthetic or project-authored under Apache-2.0.
No account credentials, tokens, payment data or private customer data are present.
